information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjIwNjQ5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--02fb31b61cbf76ea532ad4e740996fb5929ac505/SCP_DarkTheme%20(1).png) **• If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.** **• If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification** **• Participants must bring their own cubes.** **• All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.** **• Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue.** **• In the event of a theft, injury, etc. the organization team will not be held completely or partially responsible.** **• This competition will be one of the first in the world to debut the new event: FTO (Face Turning Octahedron); and the use of 4-Pad Mode on timers for official solves.**
